children: Applications to the People's Bank of China for share repurchase and re-lending has exceeded 200 billion yuan ($29.98 billion), the central bank said on Wednesday.
The central bank has intensified the implementation of share buyback and increased re-lending policies to maintain stable capital market operations, it said.
The PBOC and financial and securities regulators had convened major banks on Monday to discuss optimising the relending policy for share buybacks and purchases.
